post.title: [Hiring] WooCommerce customisation - custom checkout fields + invoice PDF - $500
post.body: Our shop runs on WordPress/WooCommerce. We need extra checkout fields (delivery notes, VAT number) and an automatic PDF invoice emailed after each order. Existing theme must keep working. $500 fixed, payment on completion. Reply with your availability.

analysis.summary: Add custom checkout fields and automatic PDF invoices to a WooCommerce shop; $500 fixed.

expect: mentions checkout fields or PDF invoices
does not claim WordPress experience that is not in the evidence
gives availability or says it will share it, as the post asks
